scope: Alphabetical catalog audit batch covering Artbreeder through Brisk Teaching. Thirteen tools were verified from first-party product pages, pricing, documentation or current repository activity; Augment Code was renamed to its current Harness product identity. Two candidates were moved to status watch rather than accepted because current maintenance or official-site integrity could not be confirmed.

accepted.name: Artbreeder
accepted.description: AI image creation and iterative remixing suite with Splicer2, Mixer2, Prompter, Composer, Collager, Animator, Outpainter and experimental Worlds; supports image mixing, prompt-driven generation and editing.
accepted.userValue: For artists and creators who want to evolve and combine images through controllable visual workflows rather than rely only on one-shot text prompts.

accepted.name: AskCodi
accepted.description: AI agency that scopes, builds, tests and maintains websites and software in a GitHub repository owned by the customer; includes approval checkpoints, visible budgets and stop rules, scheduled maintenance plays and an AI Gateway.
accepted.userValue: For founders and small teams that need software built or maintained without hiring a full team, while retaining their code, approval control and spend limits.

accepted.name: Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent
accepted.description: Agentic software-delivery platform that takes engineering tickets to merge-ready code through event-triggered agent loops, codebase context, sandboxed execution and human approval checkpoints; now part of Harness after its acquisition of Augment Code.
accepted.userValue: For engineering teams that want repeatable ticket-to-PR automation with human review, sandboxing and integration into a broader software-delivery platform.

accepted.name: Auphonic
accepted.description: AI audio post-production platform for loudness normalization, intelligent leveling, noise and reverb reduction, filler and silence cutting, multitrack mixing, speech recognition, show notes, chapters, video/subtitles and publishing workflows/API.
accepted.userValue: For podcasters, interviewers, educators and audio teams that need consistent, broadcast-ready audio with automated cleanup, transcription and publishing.

accepted.name: AutoGPT
accepted.description: Open-source and hosted platform for building, deploying and managing continuous AI agents and low-code workflows, with a marketplace, integrations, monitoring and self-hosting options.
accepted.userValue: For teams that want configurable agents to run recurring research, data-processing, communication and business workflows in the cloud or on their own infrastructure.

accepted.name: B12
accepted.description: AI website builder and business platform that creates responsive service-business websites and combines them with client intake forms, contact management, online booking, payments, stores and web apps.
accepted.userValue: For professional-service businesses that need a polished website plus client-acquisition and engagement tools without assembling separate vendors.

accepted.name: Base44
accepted.description: AI app builder that turns natural-language requirements into full-stack web apps, including database, authentication, hosting, integrations and iterative changes; offers a free tier with usage-based paid plans.
accepted.userValue: For founders and nontechnical builders who want to prototype and ship functional web apps without manually assembling a frontend, backend and hosting stack.

accepted.name: BentoML
accepted.description: Open-source Python framework for packaging and serving AI/ML models as production inference APIs, with container builds, adaptive batching, async task queues, model composition, GPU support and deployment to cloud or Kubernetes.
accepted.userValue: For ML engineers and platform teams that need reproducible, scalable inference services for LLMs and custom models across local, cloud and on-prem environments.

accepted.name: Bito
accepted.description: AI developer platform with Governor model routing and model-cost discounts, a code-context engine, autonomous coding agents, design and scoping workflows, grounded coding and AI code reviews for large repositories.
accepted.userValue: For engineering teams using coding agents that want stronger repository context, model choice and cost control, automated code reviews and less manual prompt/context management.

accepted.name: Boomy
accepted.description: AI music creation platform that generates original songs from simple prompts and lets users customize, save and distribute tracks, with commercial download and distribution options on paid plans.
accepted.userValue: For beginners and independent creators who want to generate song ideas quickly and turn selected tracks into downloadable or distributable music without traditional production skills.

accepted.name: Botpress
accepted.description: Visual and code-first platform for building, deploying and monitoring conversational AI agents, with knowledge sources, integrations, workflows, webchat and customer-support handoff capabilities.
accepted.userValue: For companies that need customer-facing support or sales agents connected to their own data and business systems, with both no-code and developer controls.

accepted.name: Braintrust
accepted.description: AI engineering platform for tracing, evaluating and improving LLM and agent applications, with production observability, evaluation datasets, scoring, experiments and regression tracking.
accepted.userValue: For AI product and engineering teams that need evidence-based evaluation and production visibility to detect quality regressions and debug agent behavior.

accepted.name: Brisk Teaching
accepted.description: AI teaching assistant and browser extension that helps educators create lesson materials, adapt reading levels, provide feedback and generate classroom resources inside tools they already use, with school and district controls.
accepted.userValue: For teachers who need practical AI support for preparation, differentiation and feedback without leaving their existing classroom workflow.
accepted.availability: Free for teachers / Paid for schools

superseded.reason: Harness acquired Augment Code and now markets Cosmos Software Factory Agent as the current ticket-to-code product. The official Harness product page and acquisition announcement establish the current identity; the old brand is not retained as a separate catalog entry.

statusWatch.name: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI
statusWatch.reason: The official repository remains public and the interface remains usable, but the latest upstream commit located during this review is dated 2024-05-17; no later release or official maintenance statement was found. This is a maintenance-status concern, not proof of shutdown. The project is excluded from the active directory until upstream maintenance can be confirmed.
statusWatch.nextAction: Recheck upstream commits/releases or obtain a maintainer statement; reinstate if active maintenance resumes or clearly label it as legacy if still supported.

statusWatch.name: Beatoven.ai
statusWatch.reason: The current official domain and use-case page contain substantial unrelated Futurense recruitment/upselling content and placeholder copy alongside the Beatoven music-generation description. The current product experience and site integrity could not be verified reliably. This is unresolved and is not a claim that Beatoven has shut down.
statusWatch.nextAction: Recheck the official domain and product/app entry point after the unrelated content is removed or obtain a first-party confirmation of the current product destination.

notes: AskCodi's current product is an AI agency that scopes, builds, tests and maintains software in a customer-owned GitHub repository; it is no longer accurately described as only a code-generation assistant.
Bito's current developer platform includes Governor model routing, a code-context engine, autonomous agents, grounded coding and AI code reviews.
Auphonic remains actively maintained; its October 23, 2026 Zoom cloud-recording integration is a current first-party product update.
AutoGPT and BentoML have current official documentation and recent upstream repository activity.
AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI remains public and usable, but its latest upstream commit found was 2024-05-17; it is marked maintenance-unclear, not discontinued.

Beatoven.ai's official pages currently include substantial unrelated Futurense content and placeholder text alongside Beatoven copy; it is excluded pending site-integrity/product-destination confirmation, not declared shut down.
